text:
Here's a gentle 3-day Jaipur plan for your parents, with a slow start each morning and a rest after lunch.

Day 1, forts and old city: Amber Fort early, before the crowds and heat, with a photo stop at Jal Mahal on the way back. After lunch and a rest, see City Palace and Jantar Mantar, then Hawa Mahal from outside at sunset.
Day 2, culture and shopping: Govind Dev Ji temple in the morning, then Albert Hall Museum. After a rest, stroll Johari Bazaar for jewellery and Bapu Bazaar for textiles. Dinner at Chokhi Dhani for Rajasthani food and folk music.
Day 3, easy and scenic: Panna Meena ka Kund and Sisodia Rani Garden in the morning, a last chai and shopping stop, then head home.

Book a car with a driver for all three days. It saves their knees, and Amber Fort has steep slopes, so a jeep up is easier than walking. Late October to March is the best time for weather. Do they walk comfortably, or should I make it lighter? Tell me their dates and I'll shape it around those.

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
7:05 AM

National Museum Delhi is open Tue to Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Mondays and national holidays. It is open today, Sat 24 Oct, until 6:00 PM. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 enter free with an I-card. The museum's site lists the Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries as closed for renovation (notice dated May 29, 2023), so check that before you go. The address is Janpath, New Delhi - 110011.

From New Delhi, the daily trains for Sun 25 Oct are the Shatabdi 12002 (6:00 AM to 7:50 AM, 1h 50m), the Taj Express 12280 (6:55 AM to 9:25 AM) and the Punjab Mail 12138 (5:10 AM to 8:10 AM). The fastest overall is the Vande Bharat 22470 from Hazrat Nizamuddin (6:00 AM to 7:40 AM), then the Gatimaan 12050 (8:10 AM to 9:50 AM). Both leave from Nizamuddin, and I couldn't confirm they run on Sunday. The list I read was cut off after about 11:25 AM, and it didn't come from IRCTC, which blocked me. Check seats and fares on IRCTC yourself.
